title: Sephiria Companion Build — Best Summoner Setup (Pets, Ballista, Tablets)
description: Sephiria companion build guide: the best summoner setup — Companion Artifacts, Ballista/mines, Tablet buffs on summons, and Dimensional Pocket carry.
meta: For sephiria companion build / summoner searches.
body:
sephiria companion build searches want a summoner route: stack Companion-tagged Artifacts, keep them leveled, and let pets soak aggro while you finish elites/bosses. This page is the quick version; the builds overview covers every theme.

Core idea

  • Prioritize Companion family items early (contracts, moles, jellyfish, cushions, etc.). Community clear videos treat “get all companions online” as the first-floor job.
  • Ballista / mine-crossbow evolutions play like extra companions once mines become seeking drones.
  • Put Tablets and buffs on companions, not on random side DPS tags.
  • Companions are expensive to max—Dimensional Pocket / Willpower lines that carry items between runs make the build much smoother.

First-floor checklist

  1. Pick a weapon / combo family before the run (see weapons).
  2. Pre-load Wishing Fountain picks with Companion-family Artifacts once it is unlocked.
  3. Grab every Companion-tag item on floor one before anything shiny.
  4. Start a Ballista or mine-crossbow line as your second tag.
  5. Spend Tablets on companion damage or count, not your own DPS.

Run habits

  • Accept Storm Cloud or light fire as secondary only if it supports Ballista/mines—do not dilute five tags.
  • In co-op, companions keep drawing aggro so human players can focus mechanics.
  • After bosses, rebuild adjacency so Companion pieces stay bonded.

Common mistakes

  • Spreading early picks across five families — companions only come online when the family is stacked.
  • Buffing your own damage while pets die — Tablets and level-ups belong on the summons.
  • Ignoring carry lines: without Dimensional Pocket / Willpower progress you rebuild the set every run.

Quick FAQ

What counts as a Companion item?
Contracts, moles, jellyfish, cushions and similar pet-family Artifacts — anything that spawns or buffs a summon.

Do companions hold aggro?
Yes — community clears use them as the aggro line while the player finishes elites and bosses; in co-op they do the same job for the whole team.

Is it good for Hard Mode?
It is one of the themes players carry into Root’s Retreat stages; check the Hard Mode page for what changes.

Theme-level consensus also appears in 9Puz / SlashSkill “commit to one combo family” advice. Exact item IDs shift with patches—use the Journal and this page’s video sources for current names.
